dialogue.origin: 今日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。準備が出来ましたら始めさせていただきたいと思います。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming today. We can begin whenever you're ready.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは　本日は宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.origin: 少し待っていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you please wait a moment?

dialogue.origin: はい。お待ちしています。
dialogue.content: Yes, of course. Take your time.

dialogue.origin: はい　お待たせしました　もう大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, sorry to keep you waiting. I'm ready now.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor. How can I support you today?

dialogue.origin: こんにちわ　お願いいたします　親戚のつきあい方に困っています
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you. I'm having trouble with how to deal with my relatives.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。よろしければ年令と性別を教えていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: I see. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 年齢は３１才　女子です
dialogue.content: I’m a 31-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。何とお呼びすればいいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What should I call you?

dialogue.origin: リエといいます
dialogue.content: My name is Rie.

dialogue.origin: リエさんですね。親戚のお付き合いということですが、もう少し詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Rie, I see. You mentioned dealing with relatives. Could you tell me a little more about that?

dialogue.origin: はい　私の家は近所にたくさん親戚が住んでいます
dialogue.content: Yes. Many of my relatives live nearby.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いとこや叔父さんも出入りがおおくて
dialogue.content: My cousins and uncles come and go a lot.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: しょっちゅう　家に来ては両親と話や食事などもしています
dialogue.content: They often come over to talk or have meals with my parents.

dialogue.origin: 食事はたまにですが
dialogue.content: The meals are only occasional, though.

dialogue.origin: それは落ち着かないですよね...
dialogue.content: That must make it hard to relax...

dialogue.origin: そうなのです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 特にいとこは　夜の８時過ぎた頃にでもやってきて
dialogue.content: Especially my cousin—she’ll even come by after 8 p.m.,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Uh-huh.

dialogue.origin: 勝手に家に上がってきます
dialogue.content: She comes right into the house without asking.

dialogue.origin: 気持ち的に嫌な気分を抱えてしまいますよね...
dialogue.content: That must make you feel quite uncomfortable...

dialogue.origin: 何かをもって来たと言わんばかりに　口実に上がってくるのです
dialogue.content: She comes in using the excuse of having brought something over.

dialogue.origin: やりかなれないですよね...
dialogue.content: That must be hard to deal with...

dialogue.origin: リエさんはご家族に困っていることを
dialogue.content: Rie, have you spoken to your family about how this is troubling you?

dialogue.origin: 手作りのケーキとか　何か悩みごととか言いたいみたいな
dialogue.content: Like homemade cake or wanting to talk about some problem.

dialogue.origin: お話したりしましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to them about it?

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: いえ　子供の頃から　両親は嫌な感じにはとらえていなくて
dialogue.content: No. Since I was a child, my parents haven’t really seen it as a problem.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: まだ叔父さんたちは　日中の食事の時間帯ははずしていました
dialogue.content: My uncles would at least avoid mealtimes during the day.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: で、両親も用事があれば出ていくので　子供の私たちが話相手みたいな
dialogue.content: And if my parents had to go out, we kids ended up being the ones to talk to them.

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですね...
dialogue.content: That must have been difficult for you...

dialogue.origin: 嫌な気持ちにはならなかったのです
dialogue.content: I didn't feel bad about it back then.

dialogue.origin: だけど
dialogue.content: But...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Uh-huh.

dialogue.origin: いとこは　時間を問わず　夜でも勝手にあがってきて
dialogue.content: my cousin comes in whenever she wants, even at night.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 自分の事を話だして帰ろうとしないのです
dialogue.content: She starts talking about herself and just won't leave.

dialogue.origin: いとこの方が出入りするようになってからは
dialogue.content: Since your cousin started coming by,

dialogue.origin: 期間はどの位でしょうか？
dialogue.content: how long has it been?

dialogue.origin: もう１年くらいです
dialogue.content: It's been about a year now.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私も仕事に疲れて寝たいときもあるのに
dialogue.content: Even though I’m tired from work and sometimes just want to sleep,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 彼女の性格にうんざりしています
dialogue.content: I’m fed up with her personality.

dialogue.origin: 女性の方なのですね。
dialogue.content: So your cousin is a woman.

dialogue.origin: はい　２才年下です
dialogue.content: Yes, she’s two years younger than me.

dialogue.origin: いとこの方は家が近い分、
dialogue.content: Since your cousin's house is close by,

dialogue.origin: 気軽に来ている気持ちなのかもしれませんね...
dialogue.content: she might feel like she can just come over casually...

dialogue.origin: いえ　親戚の中では車で１５分くらいだから　遠い方です
dialogue.content: No, among our relatives, she's actually one of the farther ones, about a 15-minute drive away.

dialogue.origin: リエさんとも年令が近いことでお話ししたい気持ちもあるのではないかと思いました。
dialogue.content: I thought that perhaps because you and she are close in age, she might want to talk with you.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 子供の頃は確かに　よく遊んでたし　年が近いから仲は良かったです
dialogue.content: When we were kids, we certainly played together a lot and got along because we were close in age.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Uh-huh.

dialogue.origin: 年をとるにつれ気性が激しくなり
dialogue.content: But as we grew older, her temper became more intense.

dialogue.origin: 大人になるにつれて関係は変わってきますよね。
dialogue.content: Relationships do change as we become adults.

dialogue.origin: 取り扱いが難しいです
dialogue.content: She’s difficult to deal with.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いとこの方とは何かお話しされたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever talked with your cousin about this?

dialogue.origin: この件についてですか？
dialogue.content: About this issue?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いえ　まだ一度もないです
dialogue.content: No, not once.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いとこの方はリエさんが
dialogue.content: Does it seem like your cousin

dialogue.origin: 困っている気持ちにはなかなか気づかれていない感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: hasn't really noticed that you're feeling troubled by this?

dialogue.origin: 多分気づいていないと思います
dialogue.content: I think she probably hasn’t noticed.

dialogue.origin: 職場でもいろいろな所でもめては辞めています
dialogue.content: She argues with people at her jobs and other places and then quits.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 結局　相手の事を悪くいっているし
dialogue.content: In the end, she speaks ill of the other person,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Uh-huh.

dialogue.origin: 自分の反省はないのだと思います
dialogue.content: I don't think she reflects on her own actions.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: リエさんはいとこの方と
dialogue.content: Rie, do you

dialogue.origin: 改善の為にお話してみたいという気持ちはありますか？
dialogue.content: have any desire to talk with your cousin to try to improve the situation?

dialogue.origin: なんか　普通に話せないというか
dialogue.content: It's like... I can't just talk to her normally.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: こちらも何か理由をつけて離れないと　理解できないかも
dialogue.content: She might not understand unless I make up a reason to distance myself.

dialogue.origin: お互いに気まずくなって話しづらいことってありますよね
dialogue.content: It can be awkward and difficult to talk about things with each other, can't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: リエさんの気持ちは
dialogue.content: Rie, do you feel more strongly

dialogue.origin: 彼女と良い関係になることと、
dialogue.content: about having a good relationship with her,

dialogue.origin: 距離を空けることが出来るようになることの
dialogue.content: or being able to create some distance?

dialogue.origin: どちらの気持ちがお強いですか？
dialogue.content: Which do you feel more strongly about?

dialogue.origin: それは距離を起きたいところです
dialogue.content: I'd really like to create some distance.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 彼女と距離をおける方法をよかったら一緒に考えさせて下さい。
dialogue.content: If you'd like, let's think together about how you can create some distance from her.

dialogue.origin: 親が言っても効かないし　私が言っても無駄だと思います
dialogue.content: Even if my parents say something, it doesn’t work, and I think it would be pointless if I said it.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 直接、伝えるのではなく手紙にリエさんの気持ちを書いて渡してみることはどうでしょう？
dialogue.content: Instead of telling her directly, how about writing your feelings in a letter and giving it to her?

dialogue.origin: そんな事したら　皆に見せたりして　余計に不信感でそうです
dialogue.content: If I did that, she would show it to everyone, and it would just create more distrust.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 確かにもっとやっかいなことになりかねないかもしれないですね...
dialogue.content: You're right, that could indeed make things more complicated...

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら彼女は
dialogue.content: Perhaps she...

dialogue.origin: 気性が激しい上に　人の気持ちを理解できない人ですから
dialogue.content: She's hot-tempered and can't understand others' feelings.

dialogue.origin: 職場でも人間関係でも
dialogue.content: ...at work and in her relationships...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 上手くいかなくて寂しい思いをしているのかもしれませんね...
dialogue.content: is having a hard time and feeling lonely...

dialogue.origin: リエさんに
dialogue.content: and she wants you, Rie,

dialogue.origin: 確かにそうですね
dialogue.content: That's certainly true.

dialogue.origin: 話を聞いてもらいたい気持ちがっても
dialogue.content: to listen to her,

dialogue.origin: 素直になれなくて
dialogue.content: but she can't be honest about it,

dialogue.origin: 嫌な態度を取ってしまったりしてるのかもしれないですね...
dialogue.content: so she might be taking on an unpleasant attitude instead...

dialogue.origin: いえ　嫌な態度はほとんど無いのです
dialogue.content: No, she's almost never unpleasant.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 喜怒哀楽が激しいというか
dialogue.content: It's more that her emotions are very intense.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Uh-huh.

dialogue.origin: 明るく楽しく接してくるのですが
dialogue.content: She acts cheerful and fun when she's around,

dialogue.origin: でしゃばりで
dialogue.content: but she’s pushy,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 自分の物差しで人を判断するような
dialogue.content: She judges people by her own standards.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ちょっとでも気に入らないことがあったら　攻撃体制にかわります
dialogue.content: If there’s even a small thing she doesn’t like, she switches into attack mode.

dialogue.origin: 私にではないですよ
dialogue.content: Not to me, though.

dialogue.origin: 周りの関係者にです　特に職場
dialogue.content: It's towards the people around her, especially at work.

dialogue.origin: 彼女は本当は人と関わりたくて
dialogue.content: It sounds like she really wants to connect with people,

dialogue.origin: でも自分は嫌われていると思って彼女自身、どうしていいかわからなくなってしまい
dialogue.content: but she thinks she's disliked, so she doesn't know what to do herself,

dialogue.origin: きふくが激しくなってしまっているように感じます...
dialogue.content: leading to intense mood swings...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: リエさんは彼女と接することに抵抗はありますか？
dialogue.content: Rie, do you feel reluctant to interact with her?

dialogue.origin: たまにだったら　良いですが　週に１回でもきついな
dialogue.content: Once in a while would be fine, but even once a week is tough.

dialogue.origin: 半年に１回くらいなら良いかも
dialogue.content: Maybe once every six months would be okay.

dialogue.origin: 彼女はリエさんに助けを求めているように感じるので
dialogue.content: I have the sense that she’s seeking help from you,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
リエさんが一度、彼女の話を聞いてあげることが出来たら
dialogue.content: and if you were able to just once really listen to her,

dialogue.origin: 彼女の中にある気持ちもかわっていくことが出来て
dialogue.content: her own feelings might start to change,

dialogue.origin: リエさんの家に来る回数も減り
dialogue.content: she might come to your home less often,

dialogue.origin: たまに会う形に出来るかもしれないと思ったのですがどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: and you might be able to shift to seeing her only occasionally. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: お話は聞いていますよ　来れば相手をしているので
dialogue.content: I do listen to her. When she comes, I talk with her.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: こちらが言える事はほとんど無くて　ただ自分のうさを晴らすみたいな
dialogue.content: There's almost nothing I can say; it's just like she's venting her frustrations.

dialogue.origin: こちらの話は聞く耳ないというような
dialogue.content: It's like she has no intention of listening to what I have to say.

dialogue.origin: 話すことではなく美味しいものを食べに行ったり、一緒にスポーツをしてみたりすることはどうでしょう？
dialogue.content: Instead of talking, what about going out to eat something delicious, or doing a sport together?

dialogue.origin: うんうん
ちょっと自己中心的な感じです
dialogue.content: She seems a bit self-centered.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 多分興味ない感じですね
dialogue.content: She probably wouldn’t be interested.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 彼女の趣味はご存知ですか？
dialogue.content: Do you know what her hobbies are?

dialogue.origin: スポーツを見るのは好きみたいですが　そんな時は家で見ているのでしょう
dialogue.content: She seems to like watching sports, but she probably does that at home.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 車であちこち言ったり　ケーキ作ったりですね
dialogue.content: She drives around to different places and bakes cakes.

dialogue.origin: 私がスポーツ見ないし
dialogue.content: I don’t watch sports,

dialogue.origin: お菓子も作らないので
dialogue.content: and I don’t make sweets, so—

dialogue.origin: リエさんは車も興味ありませんか？
dialogue.content: Rie, are you not interested in cars either?

dialogue.origin: 運転はしていますが
dialogue.content: I do drive,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 興味というとこまではないかな
dialogue.content: but I wouldn’t say I’m interested.

dialogue.origin: 好きなことが合うというのはなかなか難しいですよね...
dialogue.content: It's often difficult to have matching interests, isn't it...

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 家族の皆さんで何かいい案を出す話し合いをしてみるのはどうでしょう？
dialogue.content: How about discussing it with your family to see if you can come up with a good idea together?

dialogue.origin: そうですね　それはまだ考えていませんでした
dialogue.content: That's true... I hadn't thought of that yet.

dialogue.origin: 一度みんなで話あいをしてみます
dialogue.content: I'll try talking it over with everyone.

dialogue.origin: よかったです！ご家族と話し合ってみていい案が出たら
dialogue.content: That's great! If you can come up with a good idea after talking with your family,

dialogue.origin: 一度やってみると良さそうですね。
dialogue.content: it might be worth trying.

dialogue.origin: はい　自分の気持ちばかりで　周りの事を考えていなかったです
dialogue.content: Yes. I was so focused on my own feelings that I wasn't thinking about others.

dialogue.origin: 気がつきました　ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: I've realized that now. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: リエさんはしっかりした方だと感じられるので
dialogue.content: I get the impression that you’re a very grounded person, Rie, so

dialogue.origin: いえいえ
dialogue.content: Oh, not at all.

dialogue.origin: みんなで協力することで
dialogue.content: by working together with everyone,

dialogue.origin: 改善の方向へ向かえるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: you might be able to move towards improving the situation.

dialogue.origin: そうですね　みんなの意見を聞いてみたいです今日は本当にありがとうございました
dialogue.content: That's right. I'd like to hear everyone's opinions. Thank you so much for today.

dialogue.origin: リエさんのこと応援しています。
dialogue.content: I’m rooting for you, Rie.

dialogue.origin: 時間ですので　終了をお願いします　お世話になりました
dialogue.content: It's time, so I'd like to end the session. Thank you for your help.

dialogue.origin: お話しくださってありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for talking with me.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します。
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

topic.sub: 親戚との付き合い方の悩み
